title: Butter Masala
subtitle: Chicken

ingredientGroups.title: Main
items: 2 Tbsp sugar (use less with sweet onions)
½ Tbsp garam masala (recipe in link)
½ Tbsp dried fenugreek leaves (kasoori methi)

components.title: Dry Spice Mix
steps: Toast all the spices over medium heat for 30-60 seconds and set aside. Alternatively, bake them in the oven on a sheet pan at 250-275 degrees F for 15 minutes.
Cool for 5 minutes then grind into a fine powder.
Add the salt and kashmiri powder

components.title: Wet Masala Paste

items: ½ green chili, stemmed and seeded

steps: Fry the onions over high heat until golden brown and set aside.
Blend the onions, tomatoes, and garlic-ginger-chili paste until smooth.
Combine the chicken, Masala Paste, Spice Mix, lemon juice, and yogurt in the Instant pot bowl. Mix well to ensure the spices are evenly distributed.
Pressure cook the mixture for 20 minutes then Quick Release. The chicken should be tender and the oil separated.
Add the butter, sugar, garam masala, and fenugreek leaves.
Simmer with Saute mode on low heat, stirring frequently to incorporate.
Stir in the cilantro and cream, simmer for 1 additional minute.
Serve garnished with a drizzle of cream and chopped cilantro.
